How it works

## Three steps from PDF to a workbook that makes sense

1 · Drop any PDF

Conversion starts the moment the file lands - scanned report, digital statement, or a photo of a document. Files over 20 pages let you pick exactly the pages you need first.

2 · AI designs your workbook

The AI reads the document and builds a custom extraction plan for it - one sheet per table, one column per field, plus a summary sheet of key details. No templates, no column mapping.

3 · Preview and download

Review every sheet right on this page, then download the .xlsx file. Numbers arrive as numbers, so your formulas work immediately.

Whole documents, not single tables

## Most converters grab one table. This one rebuilds the document.

A 30-page financial report is not one table - it is a dozen tables, headers, totals, and notes. Typical PDF-to-Excel tools flatten all of that into one messy grid, or quietly keep only the first table they find.

This converter extracts every table into its own sheet , carries multi-page tables across page breaks, and collects the document's key fields - dates, parties, totals, account numbers - into a summary sheet. The result opens in Excel looking like something a careful analyst built by hand.

Scanned & photographed documents

OCR handles faxes, rotated scans, and phone photos - then extraction runs on the recognized text with layout intact.

Multi-page tables, merged correctly

A transaction table that spans 6 pages arrives as one continuous sheet, not 6 fragments.

Typed values, not text blobs

Amounts come through as numbers and dates as dates, so pivot tables and formulas work without cleanup.

Single-page mode

Only need the rate table on page 14? Extract just that page - nothing else is uploaded.

## Frequently asked questions

### Does it work on scanned PDFs and photos?

Yes. The converter runs OCR built for hard inputs - scans, faxes, and phone photos - and automatically corrects rotated or skewed pages before extracting. Image files (JPG, PNG, TIFF) work too, not just PDFs.

### How does it decide what goes into each Excel sheet?

The AI reads your document and designs a spreadsheet layout for it: every table it finds becomes its own sheet with one column per field, and document-level details (dates, names, totals, identifiers) go into a main sheet of field/value pairs. The preview on this page shows exactly what the downloaded workbook contains.

### What happens when I drop a file?

Conversion starts immediately - no extra buttons. Documents up to 20 pages are converted in full. For longer documents you choose: convert the first 20 pages with one click, or tap page thumbnails to convert exactly the pages you need.

### Can I convert specific pages instead of the whole document?

Yes. For documents over the 20-page free limit, page thumbnails appear - tap the pages you want (up to 20) and only those pages are cut out in your browser and uploaded. The rest of the document never leaves your machine.

### What are the limits of the free tool?

The free converter processes up to 20 pages per run, files up to 14MB, and a daily number of conversions per network. Signing up for a free DocuPipe account raises these limits substantially.

### Is my document safe? Where does it go?

Your file is sent over an encrypted connection to DocuPipe, the document platform this tool runs on, and processed on infrastructure that is SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certified and HIPAA compliant. Documents are encrypted at rest and are never used to train AI models. Details are on the security page and the trust center at trust.docupipe.ai.

### Who can see my data?

Nobody browses your files. Processing is automated end to end, results are returned to your browser session, and the compliance controls are independently audited. If you need contractual guarantees such as a BAA for health data, DocuPipe executes those on its paid plans.

### Can I run this automatically on many documents?

Yes - this tool runs on DocuPipe, a document processing platform teams use to convert thousands of documents a day through an API, integrations, and automated workflows, with an extraction schema you control. Creating an account is free.
